title: Minimum Operations to Convert All Elements to Zero
summary: Given an array of non-negative integers, determine the least number of operations needed to convert all elements to zero.
statement: Given an array of non-negative integers, determine the least number of operations needed to convert all elements to zero. An operation consists of selecting a subarray and setting all occurrences of the minimum value in that subarray to zero.
constraints: nums has up to 100,000 nonnegative integers.
An operation chooses a subarray and turns every occurrence of its minimum positive value to zero.
Return the minimum operations required to make the whole array zero.
hints: Equal positive minima can share an operation only while no lower value has separated their active region.
Maintain increasing active value levels; pop completed larger levels and push a new nonzero level only when distinct.
For each value, pop and count while top>value; push value if positive and different; count all remaining levels.
Each popped level must end before the smaller barrier, while identical surviving tops represent occurrences removable together.
editorial: Each popped level must end before the smaller barrier, while identical surviving tops represent occurrences removable together.

tests.explanation: Selecting the second position removes value two in one operation.
Remove both ones together, then the separated three and two, for three operations.
